info.title: Simple Ride API
info.description:
Ride hailing for Ethiopia. Conventions: camelCase JSON; money in integer **santim** (1 ETB = 100);
coordinates as `{ lat, lng }`; timestamps ISO-8601 UTC; errors as `{ error: { code, message, details } }`
with stable codes (docs/ERRORS.md). Breaking changes go to /api/v2.

**Realtime (Socket.IO, `auth: { token }`):** server → driver `trip:offer`; server → both parties
`trip:updated` (the Trip); server → rider `driver:location` `{ tripId, lat, lng, heading }`;
server → driver `driver:availability`; driver → server `driver:location` `{ lat, lng, heading? }`.
Treat events as hints and re-fetch GET /trips/{id} after reconnecting.

message.description: Developer-facing message; show your own localised text

accessToken.description: JWT, ~15 minutes. Send as Authorization: Bearer

refreshToken.description: Opaque. Store securely; rotated on every refresh

refreshToken.description: Opaque. Store securely; rotated on every refresh

path.description: Route as [lng, lat] pairs (GeoJSON order); empty for estimates

overtimeAmount.description: Extra minutes charged at completion, capped (santim)

ridePin.description: Only returned to the rider; the driver asks for it at pickup

overtimeAmount.description: Extra minutes charged at completion, capped (santim)

ridePin.description: Only returned to the rider; the driver asks for it at pickup

nextBefore.description: Pass as ?before= to load the next page; null at the end

threshold.description: Below this the driver can't go online or get offers

warningLevel.description: Below this, ask the driver to top up

customCommissionBps.description: Custom rate set by admin; null = default

acceptanceRate.description: Share of recent offers accepted (0–1); null before any offers

rejectReason.description: Shown to the driver when rejected

url.description: PUT the file here before it expires

required.description: Approval needs every one of these approved

cashCollected.description: Fares the driver received in cash

paidToWallet.description: Net of non-cash trips credited to the wallet

status.description: "ok" when the database and Redis respond
